messages:
mike: Quick idea — build a per-invocation econ snapshot panel for the console (7d window). Shows token cost, cache savings estimate, and model-variant delta. Thinking about how to attribute cache credits when prefix hits cross routes.

sophia: Love it. UX: sparkline + current unit cost + projected monthly spend. Also a breakdown by model SKU + quantization/precision.

jordan: Question: do we show amortized cache credits per invocation or only aggregated per-tenant? Both might confuse users.

ravi: We need deterministic attribution. Proposal: attribute prefix/KV cache savings to the route that created the prefix (origin route) unless it’s explicitly shared. Quick example SQL to approximate savings:
```
SELECT route, SUM(tokens_saved * model_unit_price) AS savings
FROM cache_hits_sampled
GROUP BY route;
```
This is sampled but straightforward to explain.

olivia: Edge cases: sticky routing + fallbacks will double count unless we tag cache entries with routing_id + model_variant. Also surface sample_rate and confidence.

mike: Agreed. On the UI we can show an "estimated cache credit" with a confidence badge. Tooltip: "estimates use sampling; confidence reflects sample rate and attribution ambiguity."

sophia: :thumbsup: Can the per-invocation drilldown modal show prompt fingerprint (not raw text), token counts, model SKU, quant flags, and the cache-hit chain? We need to redact PII.

jordan: Yes — show prompt fingerprints (hashed + truncated) instead of raw prompts. Also surface which kernel/quant path was used.

ravi: Backend telemetry proposal: new fields `cache_hit_chain` (array of {route, model_sku, tokens_saved}), `sample_rate`, `attribution_method`. Note: consider compression to avoid payload bloat.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to staging for branch econ-panel at 2026-04-02T03:00Z :rocket:

olivia: Rollouts UX note: when we swap model variants, show a delta card with cost delta and quality risk (linked to eval prompt set). Annotate windows where sticky routing still drains the old cache.

mike: Implementation plan: frontend mock -> staging API -> lightweight sampling job to backfill 7d -> iterate. I'll open a PR with mock screenshots and API shape.

sophia: Also can we add a toggle: "charge cache savings to origin route" vs "spread credits across downstream consumers"? Product wants both for experiments.

mike: Yep. Default to "origin route" and expose an opt-in beta toggle. Tagging product in the PR.

mike: @sophia @jordan I'll need API shape review once PR is up.

jordan: Will review. Main asks: include `model_version` and `quant_flags` in the telemetry contract, and document sampling semantics.

ravi: Add `inflight_token_count` so the cost estimator can account for tail token inflation on long-lived streams.

olivia: If sampling is used, put a clear UI footnote: "estimates based on X% sample" and link to sampling config & confidence calcs.

sophia: :eyes: timeline?

mike: Staging deploy + mock screenshots by EOD Wed. Product review Thurs. Beta in console Mon next week.

sophia: Nice.

mike: Thanks everyone — I'll post the PR link here when ready.
